profile.summary: George Hills is a third-party administrator based in California. It handles liability, property and medical-malpractice claims, manages related lawsuits, and recovers money from responsible parties (subrogation) for public entities such as cities, counties, special districts and educational institutions, and for private insurance carriers. The company has operated since the 1950s.
